text: Implemented one canonical sparse-weight helper for all three affected paths. Frame identity now hashes drop0(general Csparse) i/p/x/Dim; dense and sparse equal matrices share identity; stored explicit zeros normalize away; 1e-12 changes separate. Additive measurement and decomposition adapters iterate sparse rows without densifying. Focused tests pass; a 50k x 50k identity frame hashes in 0.041s with about 0.76 MiB identity payload instead of an 18.6 GiB dense coercion. Full realistic searchlight gate remains pending.
